dct_description_sm: This work is part of the Integrated Assessment of Climate Change Impacts and Adaptation Options in Nunavut Communities, co-managed by the Government of Nunavut and Natural Resources Canada.  The direct objective of this project is to identify and categorize landscape hazards in Clyde River, Nunavut.  The purpose of this data set is to characterize the sediment in Clyde River to determine how the landscape will respond to external stresses.
dct_title_s: Characteristics of sediment in Clyde River, Nunavut
